quick_skim.title: GUIDE: Designer-in-the-loop Authoring of Conformant Generative User Interfaces
quick_skim.abstract: Generative User Interfaces (GenUIs) enable applications to generate interfaces on demand from user needs and context. Like conventional UIs, they must still reflect designers' intent and conform to requirements such as brand identity. Unlike conventional UIs, designers cannot directly specify or see every interface a GenUI may produce, making design intent harder to enforce. We introduce GUIDE (GenUI Development Environment), a system that lets designers continuously inspect and refine GenUI behavior as they create and edit interfaces. GUIDE uses designers' modifications and interactions to adapt GenUIs through prompt optimization and a novel adaptive conformance scoring model. We validate GUIDE's scoring model and system. The scoring model matched or outperformed proprietary LLM baselines on held-out comparisons of real and synthetic application screens. In a study with 12 UI/UX practitioners, participants found GUIDE effective and usable and significantly preferred aligned outputs over a strong baseline using exemplars and a model-generated design.md.
quick_skim.llm_evidence_en: Generative UIs adapt to user needs and context via designer-in-the-loop prompt optimization

quick_skim.llm_tldr_en: Introduces GUIDE, a designer-in-the-loop system that adapts generative user interfaces to user needs and context using prompt optimization and adaptive conformance scoring.
quick_skim.llm_tldr_cn: 生成式用户界面需要按用户需求与上下文即时生成，同时满足设计师意图和品牌规范，但设计师难以预先规定所有界面。本文提出GUIDE开发环境，让设计师持续检查和修正GenUI行为，并通过提示优化与自适应一致性评分模型进行适配。系统验证表明该评分模型和交互机制能帮助约束生成界面的合规性。这项工作为个性化生成界面中的可控适配提供了设计工具。
